posts.text:
Donald Trump is living in an alternate reality and Americans are suffering the consequences.

Video

DHS has been shut down now for over sixty days for one reason: Republicans have been so paralyzed by their own dysfunction that they cannot govern.

Democrats are not the ones dragging this shutdown on—this all falls on the @SenateGOP and @HouseGOP, who are too busy fighting with each other.

Trump’s Big Ugly Bill turned out to be a giant scam for most Americans:

—The promised extra $1,000+ was false, with the average refund being less than one-third of that
—Any tax benefits families may have received have already been devoured by rising costs from his tariffs and his reckless war
—While the average American is paying more, the ultra-rich will see their taxes cut by more than a trillion dollars over the next decade

Trump lost. Again. 
 
The Second Avenue Subway is back on track and will be delivering expanded service to New York commuters from East Harlem, Uptown, the Bronx, and beyond – whether Trump likes it or not.


POLITICO (@politico)

Trump administration plans to release money for Second Avenue Subway after MTA lawsuit dlvr.it/TS4LrZ




— https://nitter.net/politico/status/2044838540283084991#m

Here’s the truth:

If you are a hotel or casino owner in Las Vegas, or a multi-millionaire, Trump’s tax policies have been very good to you.

But if you’re a hotel staffer, waiter, janitor, or a delivery driver, Trump’s tax policies don’t come close to undoing the economic damage he’s done to you and your family.


News 4 Reno (@News4Reno)

President Trump is scheduled to arrive in Las Vegas on Thursday to tout his tax policies, a day after the deadline for federal returns. mynews4.com/news/nati

Trump tried everything to cover for Ticketmaster’s price manipulation and screw over concert-goers.

But these jurors told the truth: Ticketmaster is a monopoly driving up prices for your favorite events.

This is a good first step towards holding Ticketmaster accountable and finally bringing fairness to the ticket market.


NY AG James (@NewYorkStateAG)

We just won our trial against @LiveNation and @Ticketmaster.
 
A jury ruled in our favor and is holding the companies responsible for their il

Donald Trump is angry that his own policies have driven up prices and killed jobs, but instead of owning up to his mistakes he is looking for someone else to blame and causing even more chaos in the economy in the process.

Privately? Republicans are petrified of Trump’s war.
 
Publicly? Silence.
 
In fact, Republicans just voted AGAINST our War Powers Resolution to end Trump’s Iran war. @SenateDems will keep forcing these votes and putting Republicans on the record – stand with us and end the war, or cave to Trump and continue it.

Today is Tax Day.

Trump promised tax relief. But rising costs from his war in Iran and his price-spiking tariffs have wiped out any extra tax refund Americans will see this year.

HAPPENING NOW: We're forcing a vote on another War Powers Resolution – our fourth since this war began.
 
If Republicans vote no yet again, we will continue to force votes on these resolutions every week until this war ends or Republicans finally find the courage to stand up to Donald Trump.
Where are Senate Republicans? Months into this war, they’ve refused to restrain Trump’s war of choice and have had no hearings.

I met with Emma Willis, wife of actor Bruce Willis who is living with frontotemporal dementia (FTD)—a type of dementia affecting thousands of Americans and their loved ones.

I am committed to ensuring federal funding for FTD research, and to advocating for caregiver support + improving health outcomes for people living with this disease.
Donald Trump’s handling of Operation Epic Fury has been an epic failure.

The only time I’ve ever agreed with @SenTuberville.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Sen. Tuberville: "Hell, we ain't done anything in the majority. Why should we keep the majority? We've got one bill passed and that was President Trump pushing and pushing and pushing. It's embarrassing."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/atrupar/status/2044426258671415450#m

My thoughts and prayers are with Kent and his family during this difficult time.
 
For more than a decade, Kent has led Syracuse University with his wide-ranging intellect, kind-hearted empathy, and grand vision. To his everlasting credit, Kent has always seen the extraordinary, untapped potential in Syracuse, a community that many had wrongly written off as having seen its best days pass by. 
 
I will be praying for him as he courageously fights this next battle.


Luke Radel (@lukeradel)

News
Because Trump’s tax cuts weren’t meant to help working families—they were meant to reward the ultra-wealthy.

The GOP has given up on trying to win over the electorate by delivering results, so instead they’re trying to change the electorate with their SAVE Act.

It would purge millions of American citizens from the voter rolls. It would make it harder for married women to vote. It would kill online, mail, and DMV registration.

The only thing Republicans are trying to save in the next election is their own skin.
Putin and his oligarch buddies are laughing all the way to the bank thanks to Trump’s war.
